template_data.lead_html: No past performance? You're probably not as stuck as you think.

rows.what_html: The 'we don't qualify' assumption — almost always wrong for commercial performers
GSA Schedule requires commercial PP — not a federal contract history you don't have yet
Teaming puts a prime's track record behind you — map them before the Schedule even lands

template_data.closer: THE CREDENTIAL GETS YOU IN. TEAMING GETS YOU THERE.
